name.en: Ramming H-pile fixed-tilt table (section not confirmed)
name.es: Mesa fija con pilote H de hincado (sección no confirmada)

description.en: Fixed-tilt ground table supported by steel piles rammed into the soil. The H-pile reference is a W6x9 wide-flange section offered for solar posts by Gerdau (dimensions converted from inches, unverified). The pile length, embedment, steel grade and galvanizing are not stated in any source reviewed, so the element length is a placeholder. Confirm with a supplier datasheet before modelling.
description.es: Mesa fija de tilt en suelo sobre pilotes de acero hincados en el terreno. La referencia de pilote H es una sección de ala ancha W6x9 que Gerdau ofrece para postes solares (dimensiones convertidas de pulgadas, sin verificar). La longitud del pilote, el empotramiento, la calidad del acero y el galvanizado no constan en las fuentes revisadas, por lo que la longitud del elemento es un marcador. Confirmar con la ficha de un proveedor antes de modelar.

typical_use: Ground-mount tables where ramming is feasible and an H section is specified by the supplier.

materials.material: Structural steel, grade not stated (Gerdau: all standard structural grades)

installation_notes: Sadef states an installation rate of more than 250 rammed piles per day per machine and recommends rammed piles for stable soil (section and dimensions not stated).
Ramming versus driven and pull-out resistance require a soil study by the engineer; not covered by the sources.
